title: [dhcp6relay] Segfault can be seen when updates are made to DHCP_RELAY table
author: vivekkarri
body:
<!--
     If you are reporting a new issue, make sure that we do not have any duplicates
     already open. You can ensure this by searching the issue list for this
     repository. If there is a duplicate, please close your issue and add a comment
     to the existing issue instead.

     If you suspect your issue is a bug, please edit your issue description to
     include the BUG REPORT INFORMATION shown below. If you fail to provide this
     information within 7 days, we cannot debug your issue and will close it. We
     will, however, reopen it if you later provide the information.

     For more information about reporting issues, see
     https://github.com/Azure/SONiC/wiki#report-issues

     ---------------------------------------------------
     GENERAL SUPPORT INFORMATION
     ---------------------------------------------------

     The GitHub issue tracker is for bug reports and feature requests.
     General support can be found at the following locations:

     - SONiC Support Forums - https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/sonicproject

     ---------------------------------------------------
     BUG REPORT INFORMATION
     ---------------------------------------------------
     Use the commands below to provide key information from your environment:
     You do NOT have to include this information if this is a FEATURE REQUEST
-->

#### Description

**Non-Functional:** Updates made to DHCP_RELAY table after process start could potentially result in dhcp6relay crash

**Technically, this isn't a functional issue because user is expected to restart dhcp_relay service after any config changes, so core generated wouldn't interrupt anything, but logs like this can appear**

`Oct 24 06:39:42.190618 r-leopard-45 INFO kernel: [ 3835.911499] dhcp6relay[91002]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f71be460430 sp 00007fff2d552fb8 error 4 in libswsscommon.so.0.0.0[7f71be446000+5c000]
`

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:

Note: Not very easy to repro

This is seen during our internal testing, which removes dhcp_relay config, restarts the service and tests for msgs relayed. 

1. Have multiple dhcpv6 servers configured and restart the dhcp_relay container
2. Remove one or a few servers 
3. Send one of these msg types https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-dhcp-relay/blob/202012/src/relay.cpp#L754 from the client and expect to see a core dump.


#### Triaging:

Although there is a requirement on user to restart the service after any config changes, the existing dhcp6relay logic subscribes to DHCP_RELAY table and continuously monitors for any updates in a separate thread. 

```
(gdb) thread 2
(gdb) bt
#0  0x00007f71bdfe538f in epoll_wait (epfd=6, events=events@entry=0x7f71b8000e80, maxevents=maxevents@entry=1, timeout=timeout@entry=1000) at ../sysdeps/unix/sysv/linux/epoll_wait.c:30
#1  0x00007f71be48934f in swss::Select::poll_descriptors (this=0x560b1825b3a0 <swssSelect>, c=0x7f71bde0ae90, timeout=1000) at select.cpp:98
#2  0x00007f71be48957b in swss::Select::select (this=this@entry=0x560b1825b3a0 <swssSelect>, c=c@entry=0x7f71bde0ae90, timeout=timeout@entry=1000) at select.cpp:167
#3  0x0000560b18245a2c in get_dhcp (vlans=vlans@entry=0x7fff2d553550) at ./src/configInterface.cpp:57
#4  0x0000560b18245aa8 in handleSwssNotification (vlans=0x7fff2d553550) at ./src/configInterface.cpp:78
#5  0x00007f71be405327 in ?? () from /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libboost_thread.so.1.71.0
#6  0x00007f71be0b3fa3 in start_thread (arg=<optimized out>) at pthread_create.c:486
#7  0x00007f71bdfe506f in clone () at ../sysdeps/unix/sysv/linux/x86_64/clone.S:95
```

The issue lies in the unsafe way both the threads operate on https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-dhcp-relay/blob/202012/src/main.cpp#L26 the vlans array.

Thread 2 after receiving a notification appends to vlans array https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-dhcp-relay/blob/202012/src/configInterface.cpp#L144. 

Thread 1 would've already added libevent callbacks based on the the address of individual objects present in the vlans array i.e. `&vlans[i]` https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-dhcp-relay/blob/202012/src/relay.cpp#L959 & https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-dhcp-relay/blob/202012/src/relay.cpp#L987

vector might reallocate the objects present in the existing array to a different location in memory and might deallocate existing objects i.e. the prev &vlan[i] is deallocated and is unsafe to use but the callbacks still use the stale reference and this might result in segfault.

```
(gdb) thread 1
(gdb) bt
#0  swss::RedisContext::getContext (this=this@entry=0x0) at dbconnector.cpp:464
#1  0x00007f71be45868b in swss::RedisReply::RedisReply (this=0x7fff2d553180, ctx=0x0, command=...) at redisreply.cpp:35
#2  0x00007f71be458d32 in swss::RedisReply::RedisReply (this=0x7fff2d553180, ctx=<optimized out>, command=..., expectedType=3) at redisreply.cpp:69
#3  0x00007f71be4608f9 in swss::DBConnector::hset (this=this@entry=0x0, key="DHCPv6_COUNTER_TABLE|", field="Information-Request", value="1") at dbconnector.cpp:660
#4  0x0000560b1823a6ee in update_counter (state_db=..., counterVlan="DHCPv6_COUNTER_TABLE|", msg_type=11 '\v') at /usr/include/c++/8/bits/stl_tree.h:984
#5  0x0000560b1823b707 in callback (fd=<optimized out>, event=<optimized out>, arg=0x560b19d44e00) at /usr/include/c++/8/ext/atomicity.h:96
#6  0x00007f71be4f29ba in ?? () from /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libevent-2.1.so.6
#7  0x00007f71be4f3537 in event_base_loop () from /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libevent-2.1.so.6
#8  0x0000560b1823a274 in signal_start () at ./src/relay.cpp:893
#9  0x0000560b1823d185 in loop_relay (vlans=vlans@entry=0x7fff2d553550) at /usr/include/c++/8/bits/char_traits.h:287
#10 0x0000560b1823995b in main (argc=<optimized out>, argv=<optimized out>) at ./src/main.cpp:28

(state of the vlan array, reflects the new allocation)
(gdb) f 9
gdb) p &vlans[0][1]
$5 = (relay_config *) 0x7f71b80011f0
(gdb) p &vlans[0][0]
$6 = (relay_config *) 0x7f71b8001140
(gdb) p &vlans[0][2]
$7 = (relay_config *) 0x7f71b80012a0

(stale reference passed to callback)
(gdb) f 5       
#5  0x0000560b1823b707 in callback (fd=<optimized out>, event=<optimized out>, arg=0x560b19d44e00) at /usr/include/c++/8/ext/atomicity.h:96
(gdb) p config 
$8 = (relay_config *) 0x560b19d44e00

Additional info:
(gdb) p *config
$16 = {local_sock = 17, server_sock = 18, filter = 14, link_address = {sin6_family = 10, sin6_port = 0, sin6_flowinfo = 0, sin6_addr = {__in6_u = {
        __u6_addr8 = "i\000\000\001", '\000' <repeats 11 times>, "\001", __u6_addr16 = {105, 256, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 256}, __u6_addr32 = {16777321, 0, 0, 16777216}}}, sin6_scope_id = 0}, 
  state_db = std::shared_ptr<swss::DBConnector> (empty) = {get() = 0x0}, interface = "", mux_key = "", servers = std::vector of length 0, capacity 0, 
  servers_sock = std::vector of length 0, capacity 0, is_option_79 = true, is_interface_id = false}

(gdb) p vlans[0][1]
$17 = {local_sock = 17, server_sock = 18, filter = 14, link_address = {sin6_family = 10, sin6_port = 0, sin6_flowinfo = 0, sin6_addr = {__in6_u = {
        __u6_addr8 = "i\000\000\001", '\000' <repeats 11 times>, "\001", __u6_addr16 = {105, 256, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 256}, __u6_addr32 = {16777321, 0, 0, 16777216}}}, sin6_scope_id = 0}, 
  state_db = std::shared_ptr<swss::DBConnector> (use count 3, weak count 0) = {get() = 0x560b19d47430}, interface = "Vlan690", mux_key = "VLAN_MEMBER|Vlan690|", 
  servers = std::vector of length 1, capacity 1 = {"6900::2"}, servers_sock = std::vector of length 1, capacity 1 = {{sin6_family = 10, sin6_port = 8962, sin6_flowinfo = 0, sin6_addr = {
        __in6_u = {__u6_addr8 = "i", '\000' <repeats 14 times>, "\002", __u6_addr16 = {105, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 512}, __u6_addr32 = {105, 0, 0, 33554432}}}, sin6_scope_id = 0}}, 
  is_option_79 = true, is_interface_id = false}
```

#### Fix:
Easiest fix would be not to subscribe DHCP_RELAY table and just read from it once. In general, the unsafe operations on vector must be avoided


#### Describe the results you expected:


#### Output of `show version`:

Originally seen on 202012, but can be seen on other images as well.

[sysdump_test_dhcp6_relay_remove_dhcp_server.tar.gz](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/files/9864462/sysdump_test_dhcp6_relay_remove_dhcp_server.tar.gz)

[debs.tar.gz](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/files/9864497/debs.tar.gz) debs and their dbg symbols

linkedPullRequests.title: disable relay configuration dynamic change
linkedPullRequests.author: jcaiMR
linkedPullRequests.body:
#### Why I did it
disable dhcp relay configuration dynamic change, since current code not ready for that.

fix issue
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/12496

#### How I did it
1. Instead of applying new configuration, we will give a warning message when configuration change detected after container bootup. User need manually restart container to take effect. 
2. still keep config monitor thread as in future we may reopen it after resolve dynamic config change issue 

#### How to verify it
Verify by script for regression, and UT with check syslog after configuration change.
